Cardiovascular Pharmacogenetics & Biobank Linkage


Deterministic individual-level linkage across Danish nationwide health registries and the Copenhagen Hospital Biobank (CHB) evaluating clinical outcomes associated with CYP2C19 loss-of-function variants in antiplatelet therapy, SLCO1B1-mediated statin uptake, and bedside clinical decision support.


2025






SAMSON-2 Trial


Investigator-initiated, nationwide, 11-center randomized controlled trial comparing a digital double-blind N-of-1 trial platform against guideline-directed standard care titration to systematically differentiate statin-associated muscle symptoms from expectation bias. Funded by the Capital Region of Denmark, Bispebjerg Hospital, and Hørslev-Fonden.


2024






TDM-VISION


Prospective clinical research project evaluating therapeutic drug monitoring algorithms and pharmacokinetic-pharmacodynamic exposure metrics for targeted oral therapies (ibrutinib and venetoclax) in chronic lymphocytic leukemia. Funded by the Danish Cancer Society (DKK 2.3M).


2024






SPOCK Trial & European PGx Networks


Multinational European clopidogrel pharmacogenomics consortium investigating CYP2C19 genotype-guided antiplatelet therapy, alongside active working group participation in COST Action CardioPharmGeneNet and CPIC guideline development.

I am a clinical pharmacologist studying how pharmacogenetic test results change prescribing and patient outcomes. I combine Danish national registry data with prospective clinical trials to measure whether genotype-guided dosing reduces adverse drug reactions and treatment failures.
My current work focuses on CYP2C19-guided antiplatelet therapy, SLCO1B1 genotyping for statin intolerance, and therapeutic drug monitoring of targeted cancer therapies.
